parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment is not grounded in a specific section, table, or figure of the paper, but it does reference a concrete methodological aspect—producing annotations using one translator per language—which the authors could reasonably identify as part of their annotation setup. The comment is also specific about the issue: it clearly states that relying on a single translator per language is insufficient because different translators make different choices. Thus, while the authors cannot confidently pinpoint the exact section addressed, the comment clearly specifies what needs to be addressed, which corresponds to an intermediate level of grounding and specificity under the rubric rather than a fully grounded comment.
